candidate_review.scope: Only the current game's eight static HTML pages, shared CSS and JavaScript, crawl files, and original social artwork were accepted.
candidate_review.deployment_shape: The Kimi v3 HTML bodies are prerendered as eight Next.js routes through the existing root layout so the repository's commercial runtime remains intact.

design_package.validation: passed after Codex removed two unapproved fact references and the corresponding unsupported copy

375.rendered_review: All eight routes rendered in a 375px viewport with clientWidth=scrollWidth=360 after the desktop scrollbar; no horizontal overflow, broken images, or browser errors were found. The mobile menu opened with aria-expanded=true and remained within the viewport.

768.rendered_review: All eight routes rendered in a 768px viewport with clientWidth=scrollWidth=753 after the desktop scrollbar; no horizontal overflow, broken images, or browser errors were found. The homepage hierarchy, two-column cards, and navigation remained legible.

1440.rendered_review: All eight routes rendered in a 1440px viewport with clientWidth=scrollWidth=1425 after the desktop scrollbar; no horizontal overflow, broken images, or browser errors were found. The two-column hero and 1160px content shell preserved the intended hierarchy.

checks: Every published H1 omits the mutable SUSPENSION title prefix.
ThanksFor940k is the only specific current code published.
Group and VIP boosts are stated separately; no combined percentage is published.
Unsupported racing-optional and award-rate inferences were removed.
The handoff validator passes against Grok v2, the Codex approval file, and Kimi v3.

items.source: Kimi package, generated specifically for this site's Midnight Highway design
items.license: original generated artwork for this repository

items.source: Kimi package, CSS-only night highway scene and interface

checks: Skip links, semantic landmarks, one H1 per page, visible focus styles, and reduced-motion handling are present.
The mobile navigation updates aria-expanded and closes after navigation.
All internal links and fragments resolve across the eight-route page map.
The beginner checklist updates progress and persists completed steps when storage is available.
The code copy control is keyboard-operable and exposes a live status label.

commercial_runtime.evidence: The existing Adsterra components and runtime configuration files were not edited. Local production renders retained the root-layout ad shell on all three viewports.

issues_and_resolution.issue: Kimi v3 listed fact-067 and fact-041 even though the Codex fact gate rejected both.
issues_and_resolution.resolution: Removed both IDs from the design package and rewrote the three racing passages so they rely only on approved official gameplay facts. The code page publishes only ThanksFor940k.

issues_and_resolution.issue: The candidate used example combined boost percentages while saying stacking was unknown.
issues_and_resolution.resolution: Removed every combined percentage example and changed the section wording to keep the group and VIP benefits explicitly separate.

issues_and_resolution.issue: The formal repository previously deployed a one-page Next.js implementation.
issues_and_resolution.resolution: Migrated the eight HTML bodies into statically generated Next.js routes and kept the existing Adsterra root-layout components unchanged. All eight canonical routes come from one shared route map used by the sitemap.
